newsitem.title: USA: RailTex Inc March carloadings up 38 pct.
newsitem.headline: RailTex Inc March carloadings up 38 pct.

text.p: RailTex Inc said Monday that March carloadings rose 38 percent to 42,685 from 31,052 in March 1996.
The company said it had traffic gains in autos, chemicals, scrap paper and other products, but increases were partially offset by a decrease in coal shipments.
On a "same railroad" basis, carloadings fell two percent to 30,193 in March from 30,804 in March 1996.
Year-to-date March 1997 carloadings rose 27 percent to 109,698 from 86,331, the company said, and "same railroad" carloadings rose one percent to 85,981 from 85,512 in the prior year period.
